title: Marcos names COA's Gamiel Cordoba as Supreme Court associate justice
summary: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has named Commisson on Audit chairperson Gamaliel Cordoba as the new Supreme Court associate justice.

blocks.text: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has named Commisson on Audit chairperson Gamaliel Cordoba as the new Supreme Court associate justice.
Cordoba will succeed Supreme Court Amy Lazaro-Javier, who will retire on November 16, 2026. —VAL, GMA News
